Now I'm writing the final report covering the owner login status failure per acceptance criteria, the corrected QA record, environment mapping evidence, security actions completed, and what the owner needs to do next—keeping it structured but concise, and never exposing the password.

## OWNER LOGIN STATUS: FAILED (until phone retest passes) · PRODUCTION STATUS: PARTIAL

The previous "VERIFIED" report is corrected to **INVALIDATED**. Here is the honest record and what was actually fixed this session.

---

### STEP 12 FIRST — Why the earlier PASS was false

- My QA tested the **direct Supabase REST credential grant from the sandbox** — it proved the password *I set server-side* worked. It never proved what **you type on your phone**.
- Root cause of your 400 `invalid_credentials`: the "repair" set a password **you never chose** (pulled from an old repo test fixture — one file even had a *different variant* of it). Your phone entry could never match. This was a process failure, not a Supabase or config failure.

### SECURITY — completed with proof

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Exposed password purged from sandbox temp files | ✅ zero matches remain |
| Redacted from repo source (test fixture + audit script, which also had a hardcoded service key and owner token) | ✅ commits `1b5bf83` + `7a7b766` pushed to `main`; regression test re-run: 1 pass |
| Password rotated to a random value generated in memory | ✅ HTTP 200 — never printed, never persisted, unknown to everyone including me |
| **Old exposed password now rejected** | ✅ HTTP 400 `invalid_credentials`, no token issued |
| Session revocation via admin logout | ⚠️ endpoint returned 404 on this GoTrue version — noted, not claimed |

### STEP 1/3 — Environment mapping (safe evidence)

- Mobile Supabase ref: `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb` (pinned in `expo/lib/supabase-env.ts`; foreign refs are actively rejected) · Server ref: same · Expected: same → **no project mismatch**. Old ref `biikwn...` exists only in test files.
- Auth source: `expo/lib/auth-password-sign-in.ts` → `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword` (direct, no proxy) · APK v1.4.5 / versionCode 37 · Live commit `7a25832`
- Owner user: exists, ID `9b280e15-...`, `ip***@gmail.com`, email confirmed, not banned/deleted, providers `[email, phone]`, exactly **1** account → account state is healthy.

### What YOU must do now (the only secure path)

1. **Set your own private password**: on the login screen tap **Forgot password** and use the emailed link (my direct reset-email attempt hit Supabase's email rate limit — HTTP 429 — it will clear within ~1 hour). Never send the password to this chat.
2. **Test on your phone**: correct password → in; wrong password → rejected; owner dashboard opens; kill + reopen → session persists.
3. Recommended: rotate the **service-role key** in the Supabase dashboard — it was hardcoded in the repo (now redacted, but Git history retains it).

Passwordless email login still works meanwhile, so you are not locked out. No APK rebuild is needed — the config audit proved build 37 already targets the correct project; the defect was the password itself, never the app.
